name: punchwall-visual-polish-smoke
description: Validate the current forest/depth/Titan visual contracts, Hero City HUD styling, strict visual budgets, and responsive controls.

args.code:
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local root = workspace:WaitForChild("PunchWallRPG", 10)
local polish = root:WaitForChild("Polish", 10)
local city = polish:WaitForChild("City Decor", 10)
local tier = polish:WaitForChild("Wall Tier Frames", 10)
local guide = polish:WaitForChild("Guide Path", 10)
local vfx = polish:WaitForChild("VFX Anchors", 10)
local forest = polish:WaitForChild("World 1 Forest", 10)
local landmarks = root:WaitForChild("Depth Tier Landmarks", 10)
local boss=root.Walls["Titan Server Wall"] local facadeCount = 0
for _, inst in ipairs(boss:GetChildren()) do if inst.Name == "WindowFacade" and inst:IsA("SurfaceGui") then local backing=inst:FindFirstChild("FacadeBacking") local tiles=0 for _,tile in ipairs(backing and backing:GetChildren() or {}) do if tile.Name=="WindowTile" and tile:IsA("Frame") then tiles+=1 end end assert(tiles==30,"boss facade window grid missing") facadeCount += 1 end end
return HttpService:JSONEncode({ hasGuide = guide ~= nil, hasTier = tier ~= nil, hasCity = city ~= nil, hasVfx = vfx ~= nil, cityReady = #city:GetChildren() > 0, tierReady = #tier:GetChildren() > 0, depthBlocks = #root["Depth Blocks"]:GetChildren(), landmarks = #landmarks:GetChildren(), forestBudget = forest:GetAttribute("ForestVisualBudgetValidated"), forestParts = forest:GetAttribute("ForestVisualBasePartCount"), facadeReady = facadeCount == 2 and boss:GetAttribute("FacadeDetailCount")==177 and boss:GetAttribute("TextureStyle")=="TitanContainmentWall" })

steps.label: forest, depth, Titan, and polish budgets are present

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("PunchWallHUD", 5)
local reference = gui:WaitForChild("PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD", 5)
local punch = reference:WaitForChild("ActionPunch", 5)
local jump = reference:WaitForChild("ActionJump", 5)
local viewport=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
local contained=punch.AbsolutePosition.X>=0 and punch.AbsolutePosition.Y>=0 and punch.AbsolutePosition.X+punch.AbsoluteSize.X<=viewport.X and punch.AbsolutePosition.Y+punch.AbsoluteSize.Y<=viewport.Y and jump.AbsolutePosition.X>=0 and jump.AbsolutePosition.Y>=0 and jump.AbsolutePosition.X+jump.AbsoluteSize.X<=viewport.X and jump.AbsolutePosition.Y+jump.AbsoluteSize.Y<=viewport.Y
return HttpService:JSONEncode({ title = gui:FindFirstChild("StatsPanel", true):FindFirstChild("Title", true).Text, rewardPops = gui:FindFirstChild("RewardPops") ~= nil, referenceVisible=reference.Visible, legacyHidden=not gui.MobileControls.Visible, controlsContained=contained, punchMin=punch.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 and punch.AbsoluteSize.Y>=44, jumpMin=jump.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 and jump.AbsoluteSize.Y>=44 })
